import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert 'is_fraud' to a categorical type for better labeling in plots
df['is_fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set a professional style for the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure with a 1x3 subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 6))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status
sns.violinplot(x='is_fraud_label', y='amount', data=df, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis')
axes[0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)

# Plot 2: Transaction Type Counts by Fraud Status
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud_label', data=df, ax=axes[1], palette='magma')
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Type Counts by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right')

# Plot 3: Distribution of Hour of Day by Fraud Status
sns.kdeplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud_label', data=df, fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[2], palette='cividis')
axes[2].set_title('Transaction Hour Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (0-23)', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3)) # Set x-ticks for better readability
axes[2].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles/labels
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
